Container.Name: z2m-device-tracker
Container.Overview: History, health and alerts for every Zigbee2MQTT device: network map, battery tracking and issue detection. Listens to Zigbee2MQTT over MQTT and stores the history locally. Standalone Docker version of the Home Assistant app, for Home Assistant Container setups without an App store. Requires an MQTT broker, a Home Assistant long-lived access token and a UI password (8+ characters).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: History, settings (options.json) and the HACS integration's API token

Config.Name: Home Assistant config
Config.Description: Optional, read-only: Home Assistant's config folder, used for the first history import. Remove if not needed

Config.Name: UI_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Required. Password for the web UI, 8 characters or more. The UI stays locked until it is set

Config.Name: MQTT_HOST
Config.Description: Required. Hostname or IP of the MQTT broker Zigbee2MQTT uses, e.g. 192.168.1.10

Config.Name: MQTT_USER
Config.Description: MQTT username (leave empty if the broker allows anonymous access)

Config.Name: HA_URL
Config.Description: Base URL of Home Assistant, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8123

Config.Name: HA_TOKEN
Config.Description: Required. Long-lived access token: Home Assistant profile > Security > Long-lived access tokens

Config.Name: MQTT_SSL
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to connect to the MQTT broker over TLS

Config.Name: MQTT_SSL_VERIFY
Config.Description: Set to 'false' to skip TLS certificate verification (e.g. self-signed broker certificate)
